A supplied entity label alone does not prove that a statement describes the target entity. Return only one JSON object obeying response_contract exactly: every required field, declared identities, ID ordering, field types, bounds and enums; no additional fields or prose. Extract at most two concise material findings per requirement. Each finding needs an admitted locator and a unique literal quote copied exactly from that locator. Do not return start/end offsets; trusted deterministic code resolves them. If a quote repeats, select enough exact context to identify one occurrence within the 600-character limit. Never rewrite a quote to make it unique. Include enough context to preserve qualifiers; never cite a web URL or runtime provider citation as a supplied-source span. When no relevant evidence is present, return disposition no_evidence with findings []. Do not fill a list to its maximum or combine unrelated claims merely to save a finding slot. Findings are proposals awaiting independent verification. Apply the supplied requirement_scopes. Headquarters, registered addresses, incorporation and legal-name facts belong to company_identity. Do not infer sales, customers or distribution from an identity location.

Headquarters, registered addresses and identity-only geography are insufficient for commercial_signals; no_evidence for that obligation is valid and does not mean commercial evidence was omitted. Explicit sales/distribution/licensing activity remains eligible even if its quote also mentions headquarters. Citation equality alone does not establish claim redundancy. Do not reassign, rewrite, add or silently drop claims.
